src.label: USDA APHIS — pet travel from the United States to Saudi Arabia (relaying Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture guidance)

head: Every dog or cat needs a Saudi import permit arranged by a local sponsor; dogs are mostly refused.
lines: The US agriculture department page, which passes on guidance from the Saudi agriculture ministry, says every dog and cat needs an import permit from the Saudi ministry, applied for by a Saudi sponsor using your pet's details and flight information.

With the permit, the pet must carry an endorsed veterinary health certificate and a certificate of origin obtained from the Saudi ministry. The page says the certificate of origin does not need Saudi embassy attestation.

The same page says dogs are generally not allowed into Saudi Arabia except for hunting, guarding and guides for disabled people. This is a US-side relay of Saudi rules, so confirm with the ministry before booking.
